claims.claim: SENTINEL contributes effect-grounded cross-layer fault injection for evaluating an assurance chain, not deterministic enforcement itself.
claims.permitted_wording: We introduce a methodology and artifact for effect-grounded cross-layer evaluation.
claims.prohibited_wording: SENTINEL is the first deterministic guardrail.

claims.claim: The harness executes the frozen fault design, baselines, cut-set analysis, and mechanism ablations in a deterministic simulator.
claims.permitted_wording: Simulator preflight validates experiment plumbing and selected mechanism sensitivity.

claims.claim: SENTINEL has been evaluated on two realistic public systems.
claims.permitted_wording: Online Boutique and OTel Demo are pinned planned subjects with contract-tested adapters.

claims.claim: The preregistered contrasts C1-C5 have repeated live estimates and uncertainty intervals.
claims.permitted_wording: C1-C5 and the analysis boundary were frozen before live outcomes.

claims.claim: Trusted-scope and fail-closed mechanisms affect selected simulator outcomes.
claims.permitted_wording: Selected deterministic rows demonstrate mechanism sensitivity in the simulator.
claims.prohibited_wording: The ablation estimates real-world mechanism effect sizes.

claims.claim: Independent environment-state and Kubernetes-audit oracles are calibrated on both live systems.
claims.permitted_wording: Oracle and audit reconciliation contracts pass known fixtures.
claims.prohibited_wording: Live oracle fidelity has been established.

claims.claim: The complete empirical artifact has been independently reproduced.
claims.permitted_wording: The non-live artifact reproduced in a fresh environment on the same host.
claims.prohibited_wording: An independent team reproduced the empirical study.

claims.claim: The manuscript is ready for archival or peer-reviewed submission.
claims.permitted_wording: The repository contains a pre-results protocol and contract-tested artifact.
